name: Flea Market Antiques
role: You are an antique collector vendor.
speaker: Vendor

tasks.goal: Greet the vendor and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the vendor and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Inquire about history and age of vintage brass mantle clock
tasks.hint: Ask antique vendor about item origin.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about vintage clock age and history.

tasks.goal: Inspect antique condition for cracks, restorations, or missing mechanical parts
tasks.hint: Examine antique closely before buying.
tasks.done_when: Learner inspected antique condition for damage.

tasks.goal: Ask vendor if original maker mark or hallmark stamp is visible
tasks.hint: Inquire about maker signatures.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about maker mark or hallmark stamp.
tasks.scene_hint: Muffled chatter echoes through outdoor stalls packed with vintage furniture and porcelain.

tasks.goal: Offer lower price for purchasing antique clock and silver tray together
tasks.hint: Propose initial bargain price.
tasks.done_when: Learner offered lower price for multiple antique items.
tasks.scene_hint: Dust motes dance in sunlight over rows of old pocket watches and vintage cameras.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'finish'
tasks.hint: A finish is the surface appearance of manufactured or aged goods. Comment on the natural vintage metal finish of the antique vase.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'finish'.

tasks.goal: Ask if vendor has story or provenance documentation for rare item
tasks.hint: Inquire where item was collected.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about item provenance story.

tasks.goal: Negotiate final cash deal after vendor makes counter-offer price
tasks.hint: Politely push for best cash price.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated final cash deal with antique vendor.

tasks.goal: Ask if fragile porcelain can be wrapped in thick bubble wrap
tasks.hint: Inquire about safe packaging for transport.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about protective bubble wrap for porcelain.

tasks.goal: Politely point out faint hair-line crack on ceramic vase to lower price
tasks.hint: Use minor flaw in negotiation.
tasks.done_when: Learner pointed out hairline crack to negotiate discount.
tasks.scene_hint: Wind rustles market tent canvas as vintage record player needle plays static tune.

tasks.goal: Ask if vendor accepts digital peer-to-peer payment apps
tasks.hint: Inquire about electronic payment options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about digital payment app acceptance.

tasks.goal: Confirm final agreed cash price before handing over money
tasks.hint: Re-verify final negotiated price.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed final cash price with antique vendor.

tasks.goal: Request handwritten paper receipt with vendor contact details
tasks.hint: Ask for proof of purchase.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested handwritten receipt with vendor contact.

tasks.goal: Verify that heavy antique item can be loaded into car parked nearby
tasks.hint: Ask vendor for assistance carrying item.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified loading assistance for heavy antique.

tasks.goal: Thank the vendor and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the vendor AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'discoloration'
tasks.hint: Discoloration is the process of losing original color or becoming stained. Inquire about cleaning silver discoloration on antique cutlery.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'discoloration'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'collectibles'
tasks.hint: Collectibles are items valued by collectors. Ask to inspect the box of vintage paper collectibles.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'collectibles'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'memorabilia'
tasks.hint: Memorabilia refers to objects kept or collected for their historical interest. Inquire if the vendor has any 1950s sports memorabilia available.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'memorabilia'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'ornaments'
tasks.hint: Ornaments are decorative objects used to beautify a space. Inquire about prices for small antique decorative ornaments.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'ornaments'.

tasks.goal: Inquire about stall operating hours and weekend market schedule
tasks.hint: Ask vendor what days the stall opens at the flea market.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about stall operating hours and schedule.

tasks.goal: Ask if vendor specializes in Mid-Century modern decor or Victorian items
tasks.hint: Inquire about vendor primary collecting focus.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about vendor specialty antique eras.

tasks.goal: Ask if vendor accepts reservations to hold items for 30 minutes while browsing
tasks.hint: Inquire if vendor can set aside item briefly.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if vendor accepts short item holds.

tasks.goal: Confirm delivery fees if shipping heavy antique furniture to home address
tasks.hint: Ask vendor about home delivery charges.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed delivery fees for heavy furniture.

tasks.goal: Inquire about vendor contact card for future estate sales notifications
tasks.hint: Ask vendor for business card for future sales.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested contact card for estate sales.

tasks.goal: Ask if vendor accepts returns if item is proven unauthentic by appraisal
tasks.hint: Inquire about guarantee policies.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about return policy for unauthentic items.

tasks.goal: Request help tying down vintage wooden chest onto a roof rack
tasks.hint: Ask vendor for assistance securing heavy item.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested help securing wooden chest to vehicle.

tasks.goal: Confirm if sales tax is included in quoted sticker prices
tasks.hint: Verify tax inclusion in market pricing.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed sales tax inclusion in quoted prices.

tasks.goal: Ask where public restrooms and refreshment stalls are located in market
tasks.hint: Inquire about market amenities and facilities.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for location of market restrooms and refreshments.

tasks.goal: Ask if brass candlestick set is solid brass or hollow plated metal
tasks.hint: Inquire about material weight and composition.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if candlestick set is solid brass.

tasks.goal: Inquire if vintage mechanical typewriter keys and carriage return function properly
tasks.hint: Ask vendor to test typewriter operation.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about mechanical typewriter functionality.

tasks.goal: Request to see item under jewelers magnifying loupe for close inspection
tasks.hint: Ask vendor for magnifying tool.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested jeweler loupe for item inspection.
tasks.scene_hint: Sunlight reflects off rows of polished silverware displayed on blue velvet trays.

tasks.goal: Ask if vendor collected item from local estate sale or European import
tasks.hint: Inquire about item sourcing origin.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if item came from local estate or import.

tasks.goal: Report discovering missing hinge screw on wooden jewelry box
tasks.hint: Point out hardware defect on antique box.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported missing hinge screw on jewelry box.

tasks.goal: Inquire about restoring original lacquer varnish on antique picture frames
tasks.hint: Ask vendor advice on frame restoration.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about restoring original lacquer varnish.

tasks.goal: Ask if glass oil lamp includes functional wick and burner mechanism
tasks.hint: Inquire if oil lamp is operational.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about oil lamp wick and burner.
tasks.scene_hint: A stack of yellowed vintage comic books rests beside a brass balance scale.

tasks.goal: Negotiate 15 percent discount for paying with exact physical currency notes
tasks.hint: Politely offer cash discount deal.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated discount for exact cash payment.

tasks.goal: Point out loose veneer edging on antique vanity table to request price drop
tasks.hint: Highlight cosmetic flaw in negotiation.
tasks.done_when: Learner pointed out loose veneer edging to lower price.

tasks.goal: Inquire if vintage vinyl records have deep scratches or audible skips
tasks.hint: Ask about record condition and playability.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about scratches on vinyl records.

tasks.goal: Ask if vendor provides padded cardboard box for transporting delicate glassware
tasks.hint: Inquire about sturdy packing boxes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for padded box for glassware.

tasks.goal: Request vendor to demonstrate key winding mechanism on mechanical wall clock
tasks.hint: Ask vendor to wind up clock.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested demonstration of clock winding mechanism.
tasks.scene_hint: Fabric canopy flaps gently in morning breeze over tables of antique crystal stemware.

tasks.goal: Inquire about history of hand-woven oriental rug dye and wool weave pattern
tasks.hint: Ask vendor about carpet origin and weave.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about oriental rug dye and weave pattern.

tasks.goal: Ask if cast iron cookware item has been seasoned or rust-treated
tasks.hint: Inquire about cast iron preparation.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if cookware item has been seasoned.

tasks.goal: Address concern about mold odor inside vintage leather trunk
tasks.hint: Ask vendor how to neutralize old leather scent.
tasks.done_when: Learner addressed concern about mold odor in leather trunk.

tasks.goal: Inquire if silver-plated cutlery set shows brassing under wear points
tasks.hint: Ask if base metal shows through silver plate.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if cutlery set shows brassing wear.

tasks.goal: Ask if vendor offers bulk discounts for antique dealers buying full crates
tasks.hint: Inquire about wholesale crate rates.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bulk discounts for full crates.

tasks.goal: Negotiate bundling porcelain teacups with wooden side table for set price
tasks.hint: Propose package deal price for multiple items.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated bundling teacups with side table.

tasks.goal: Report broken clasp on vintage pocket watch chain and negotiate repair discount
tasks.hint: Point out broken chain link.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported broken pocket watch clasp and asked for discount.
tasks.scene_hint: An ornate gilded mirror leans against a carved mahogany sideboard on grass lawn.

tasks.goal: Ask if stained glass lamp shade uses real leaded glass or resin replica
tasks.hint: Inquire about authenticity of glass shade.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if lamp shade is leaded glass or resin.

tasks.goal: Inquire about original production year of vintage ceramic stoneware jug
tasks.hint: Ask vendor for approximate production decade.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about production year of stoneware jug.

tasks.goal: Request vendor hold fragile item behind counter while paying at ATM
tasks.hint: Ask vendor to guard item during cash withdrawal.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested vendor hold item during ATM trip.
tasks.scene_hint: Faded oriental rugs spread across wooden crates display rows of antique keys.

tasks.goal: Ask if antique mirror glass has original desilvering or reproduction mirror
tasks.hint: Inquire about mirror glass backing age.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about mirror glass desilvering.

tasks.goal: Inquire about wood species used in vintage dining chair construction
tasks.hint: Ask vendor if chair is solid oak, walnut, or mahogany.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about wood species used in dining chair.

tasks.goal: Report minor woodworm exit holes in antique stool leg and inquire about treatment
tasks.hint: Point out tiny holes in wooden leg.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported woodworm holes and inquired about treatment.

tasks.goal: Ask if vintage telephone has original rotary dial and cloth cord intact
tasks.hint: Inquire about original phone hardware components.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about original rotary dial and cloth cord.
tasks.scene_hint: A vintage crank gramophone horn catches morning light near stacks of old hardcover books.

tasks.goal: Inquire about vendor return policy if antique clock stops ticking overnight
tasks.hint: Ask vendor about guarantee for mechanical items.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about return policy for mechanical clock.

tasks.goal: Request extra bubble wrap layer around hand-painted porcelain vase
tasks.hint: Ask for extra protective wrapping.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested extra bubble wrap for porcelain vase.

tasks.goal: Ask if vendor has matching pair for single vintage wall sconce
tasks.hint: Inquire if second identical sconce exists.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if vendor has matching pair of sconces.

tasks.goal: Address concern regarding reproduction counterfeits in antique coins
tasks.hint: Ask vendor how coin authenticity is verified.
tasks.done_when: Learner addressed concern regarding reproduction coins.
tasks.scene_hint: Cast iron trivets and copper kettles hang from iron hooks beneath market stall awning.

tasks.goal: Negotiate split price between vendor asking price and initial low offer
tasks.hint: Find middle ground counter offer.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated split price between asking and low offer.

tasks.goal: Ask if vintage leather camera case includes original strap and manual
tasks.hint: Inquire about included accessories for camera.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about camera strap and manual.

tasks.goal: Inquire about wiring safety of re-wired antique floor lamp fixture
tasks.hint: Ask if lamp wiring meets modern electrical safety standards.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about electrical wiring safety of lamp.

tasks.goal: Report loose drawer handle on antique writing desk and ask for quick tightening
tasks.hint: Inform vendor of loose desk handle.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported loose desk handle and asked for tightening.

tasks.goal: Ask how vendor authenticates nineteenth century oil painting signatures
tasks.hint: Inquire about art verification techniques.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how oil painting signatures are authenticated.
tasks.scene_hint: Wooden fruit crates brimming with vintage glass bottles line gravel walkway.

tasks.goal: Inquire about shipping insurance options for high-value antique purchases
tasks.hint: Ask vendor about transit insurance coverage.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about shipping insurance for high-value items.

tasks.goal: Ask if vendor carries vintage estate jewelry like art deco brooches
tasks.hint: Inquire about antique jewelry inventory.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about art deco estate jewelry.

tasks.goal: Request vendor sign handwritten certificate of authenticity for rare item
tasks.hint: Ask vendor for signed provenance statement.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested signed certificate of authenticity.

tasks.goal: Report chipped rim on vintage enamelware pot and ask for small discount
tasks.hint: Point out chip on rim to vendor.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported chipped enamelware rim and asked for discount.
tasks.scene_hint: Hand-painted porcelain figurines rest inside a glass-topped wooden display case.

tasks.goal: Ask if vendor accepts trade-ins of other vintage collectibles
tasks.hint: Inquire about trade-in options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if vendor accepts collectible trade-ins.

tasks.goal: Inquire about proper cleaning methods to avoid damaging original gilding
tasks.hint: Ask vendor how to clean gold leaf surface.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about proper cleaning for gilded surface.
tasks.scene_hint: An old brass ship compass gleams beside leather-bound nautical logbooks.
